# DESIGN-GenericDoublePointInterpolation — completed planning pass

Codex, session codex-J6LwjP, issue1694. Claim5984385635 was confirmed by bot5984386804; the whole issue was reread. Base e765fb8b14266b1b363b842c8460264fff008158; branch codex-J6LwjP-double-point. Only the five authorized deliverables change. The new roadmap has area algebraicgeometry and parent null.

## Result and limitations

The packet has77 declaration nodes:46 lemmas,12 constructions,5 comparisons,11 theorems,2 definitions and1 application;42 API items,42 unit tests,21 planets and24 checked baseline declarations. All six stages GI.0–GI.5 are planned; none is closed. Status complete means the breadth-first target inventory is complete under PROTOCOL0. There are10 exact gaps and4 requested supplier stages, and implementation remains unchecked everywhere.

GI.0 reuses restricted-total-degree polynomials, their restricted basis and native symmetric-power/exponent counting, and plans fixed-degree homogenization, projective sections, the coefficient lattice and metric. GI.1 connects squared point ideals to the native square-zero/CRT quotient, length and actual value/gradient linear maps. GI.2 contains the residual/trace inequality, curvilinear reduction and genuine geometric-family requests. GI.3 inventories the plane and cubic routes and exact finite bases. GI.4 splits the differential Horace ranks, quartic dimension induction and exception scheduler. GI.5 supplies the affine principal-open/minor endpoint and integer box specialization, keeping a consumer’s nonzero parameter-pullback obligation explicit.

Twenty-two finite matrices are exact computational witnesses. The independent verifier reconstructs entries without importing the generator, checks projective distinctness, on-subspace and off-subspace incidence, expected pairwise span dimensions, the transverse remainder direction and modular rank. Seven collinear affine points in degree5 have rank11/21, rejecting an all-tuples endpoint. The finite arithmetic sweep passes2585 critical pairs in3≤r≤60,5≤d≤40 plus the four quartic r6/8/9 pairs. It is supplemental evidence only: an unbounded symbolic scheduler proof is still a gap.

## Validation

The pinned-index packet checker reports zero errors and zero warnings. Source-issue and source-version validators pass. The real scripts/build.py assembler, through a read-only in-memory provisional overlay, adds34 stage edges, removes none, has no defined-stage or own-node cycle, no skipped blueprint link and no new orphan edge. Its76 inherited orphan edges are reported without treating them as valid. The check covers integration of this packet, not every external declaration graph.

The **whole suggested file compiled** against the existing Mathlib082e2d3 build with Lean4.34.0-rc2, revision6a10ac8c22beadecabdbb0919c2b50214762f91d: exit0, zero errors,94 intentional admission warnings, zero other warnings and36 examples. This file has no Tau Ceti imports and is deliberately nonexhaustive. Every proposed declaration is admitted; no implementation, proof completion or admission-free axiom audit is certified. No dependency build, Lake setup/update/cache retrieval or Lean server was run. Fresh available memory was35GiB before the final compile; the serial command used one thread,8192MiB and a1200-second timeout and finished in about2 seconds.

The packet’s exact ledger has17 native signatures,4 partial native boundaries and56 unrepresented source-level targets. The two wholly unrepresented definition/construction nodes are geometric restriction rank and moving supports; their exact definitions, APIs and all six tests remain in the reader and packet. Partial native boundaries are the coefficient metric transport, quotient nilpotent example, projective length comparison and actual scheme/open/k-point comparison. The file suggests the native algebraic and polynomial-witness parts without dummy proposition carriers.

## Resume at these exact gaps

- Native affine ideal and dimension API closure: The restricted submodule, basis, derivatives, square-zero algebra and CRT statements were read at the pins. Exact bounded slack-coordinate adapter to the built Sym.equivNatSum equivalence, translated constant/linear/remainder expansion, coprime-power/infimum identities, quotient algebra linearity and range-dimension lemmas still need native proof closure and exact declaration lookup. No duplicate baseline theory is planned.
- Projective section and finite-scheme interfaces: R09.1 and SF.0 describe the required directions, but their current packets do not expose the exact projective O(d), finite twisting-section and restriction-square signatures. Suggested Lean omits these geometry nodes instead of inventing opaque carriers.
- Native plane contact proof: The BO2 proof is read and inventoried. Generic tangent/contact incidence, the double-curve divisor lemma, general-point plane-curve dimension bound and the sharp numerical reduction need native declarations in the indicated supplier direction and further decomposition. No all-plane or all-characteristic proof is certified.
- Formal finite-certificate replay: All22 explicit matrices, reconstruction, incidences, distinctness and exact modular ranks passed an independent Python verifier. Gaussian elimination, integer determinant lifting, Euler/affine comparison and generic openness have not been replayed in Lean. Finite containment evaluation samples are necessary conditions, not a certified basis of the full containing-form ideal.
- Codimension-three restriction and remainder families: Need exact images/kernels for restriction to linear spaces, the no-quadric calculation for three generic spaces, and a flat η family of length δ_r with trace δ_r−1. The r=2 remainder is explicitly the triangle cubic x₀x₁x₂ evaluated at [1:1:1]; its native replay is still open. The η is a subscheme of a double point, not a long curvilinear scheme.
- Geometric curvilinear proper-limit interface: R09.2 must expose the actual proper tangent-direction incidence and finite-flat universal family. The proof needs valuative extension/base change of a bad tuple and simultaneous mixed-parameter specialization. Arbitrary pointwise choices of bad directions do not define this family.
- Differential Horace rank refinements: Close Step1 independence under specialization and deletion of normal conditions, simple-point selection on an injectively restricted system, simultaneous nonempty-open choices and the F/G mixed-family rank bound. Each target is inventoried, but native signatures await the geometric suppliers and more declaration-sized refinements.
- Sharp arithmetic and exceptional-case scheduler: BO6.3 and the final induction were read. Complete symbolic inequalities, small-boundary division checks and proof that every critical predecessor avoids the four low-degree exception types. An exact finite arithmetic sweep is supplemental evidence only, not a proof of the unbounded scheduler.
- Coefficient metric transport: The native positive coefficient bilinear form is prototyped. A conflict-free transported NormedAddCommGroup/InnerProductSpace and the explicit integral-coordinate subgroup interface are still absent; no ambient MvPolynomial metric is assumed.
- Native minor and parameter-scheme completion: Locate the exact pinned maximal-minor/rank and determinant-degree APIs, finish k-valued point/kernel comparison and formalize the integer embedding/substitution square. Integer box nonvanishing is already built. The consumer owns the nonzero pullback for its own arithmetic parametrization.

## Supplier requests

- AlgebraicModuliForArithmeticGeometry:R09.1: Native projective space P^r_k, O(d), finite-dimensional global sections and their homogeneous-form equivalence, including affine-chart trivialization and restriction/base-change naturality.
- SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.0: Native ideal sheaves, squared finite closed subschemes, finite coordinate-algebra length, Cartier-divisor residual/trace exact sequence, section left exactness, affine quotient/chart extension and actual Spec k-valued-point comparison. Also request an owner continuation for generic smoothness, irreducible parameter products and generic rank/dimension/contact-incidence fibers needed by the plane proof.
- SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.5: Plane Cartier divisors, singular-locus double containment, Bézout and degree/incidence bounds for a reduced curve through general plane points; these are used only in the BO plane input.
- AlgebraicModuliForArithmeticGeometry:R09.2: Actual finite-flat moving-point/Hilbert incidence family and base change, locally free finite pushforward of twisting restrictions, rank semicontinuity, proper projective tangent-direction parameter and valuative extension of bad curvilinear subschemes. Supply residue-field and mixed-parameter limit control, not only a set of possible fibers.


The current SF.0 and R09.1/R09.2 packets do not expose the exact projective/Hilbert interfaces required here. The proposed SF.0 direction extension belongs in SchemeAndStackFoundations, Part II; this packet specializes it to Veronese contact geometry. No supplier deliverable was edited. There is no overlap link to rewrite for this new id. EffectiveBoundsCompactModels owns its arithmetic parametrization and its proof that the chosen minor pulls back nonzero.

## Sources and acquisition scope

Brambilla–Ottaviani arXiv:math/0701409v2 Sections1–6, pp1–19, and Couveignes’s published Annals Section3, pp491–493, were read from public PDFs. Their URLs, edition dates, byte sizes and SHA256 values are in sources-fetch.json and the packet. The two upstream style readers AlgebraicCodingTheory and AnalyticToricGeometry were read in full. Actual pinned source statements and the neighboring library audit/owner stages were checked; recoverable authored snapshots record the specific supplier claims, not a certification of their implementation.

One source misprint is recorded against BO v2 only: its r=7 Proposition5.3 base should say P⁷ rather than P⁵ for the three ambient points. ArXiv has v1/v2 and no later revision in its checked history. The primary FLORE author-copy link returned403; the publisher DOI was inaccessible. Neither unread text is treated as the version read. No broad claim of a new published error is made. BO’s historical/Waring classification material and the cited CH uniqueness proof are outside the endpoint and were not read. The reader’s exact sextic certificates replace the unique-double-cubic argument, so that unread CH result is not a hidden premise.

## Recover the evidence

Save this handoff in a review checkout and run the following Python recovery script with its path and an empty directory as arguments. It authenticates every decoded artifact; no paper PDF, extracted paper text or private machine path is stored. The suggested source is already the authorized Lean deliverable and is not duplicated here.

```python
import pathlib,re,json,gzip,base64,hashlib,sys
handoff=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
manifest=json.loads(re.search(r"<!-- MANIFEST -->\n```json\n(.*?)\n```",handoff,re.S).group(1))
blocks={name:(enc,body) for name,enc,body in re.findall(r"<!-- ARTIFACT ([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+) (text|gzip-base64) -->\n```[^\n]*\n(.*?)\n```",handoff,re.S)}
assert set(blocks)==set(manifest['artifacts'])
for name,(enc,body) in blocks.items():
    data=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(body)) if enc=='gzip-base64' else (body+'\n').encode()
    expected=manifest['artifacts'][name]
    assert len(data)==expected['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==expected['sha256'],name
    (out/name).write_bytes(data)
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Recovered and authenticated',len(blocks),'artifacts')
```

Run recovered verify_certificates.py to reconstruct and verify all22 matrices. Running certificates.py regenerates the same JSON bytes and manifest from its fixed seeds. Run arithmetic_check.py for the supplemental exact finite sweep. Run atlas_check.py with the review repository and an output JSON path to reproduce provisional assembly; use the recorded base plus these five deliverables because the surrounding atlas changes continually. Run scripts/check_blueprint.py on the packet with the pinned declaration index and JSON output. Source findings are checked with scripts/source_issues.py:check_issues and scripts/check_errata.py:versions_checked.

For a Lean replay, call replay_lean.py with the repository, an existing project whose .lake/packages/mathlib is at the pinned commit, the pinned lean executable and an output directory. It refuses the wrong pin or less than20GiB available memory and invokes one bounded serial compile. It does not install or build anything. Compare the source SHA256, exit code, errors, warning counts and examples, rather than the replay’s elapsed time or memory snapshot. The archived log sanitizes its filename to a portable relative name. Compilation remains admitted-signature evidence.
